title: C6 users bucket record
description: Account record keyed by username. disabled is additive; records without it load as enabled. password_hash is PHC argon2id and never northbound. E4b writers emit disabled explicitly. Disable empties password_hash: a pre-E4b core cannot authenticate it. Enable writes a fresh hash and disabled false. The field is opaque PHC text; shape validation never verifies a password. The owner and tenant fields retain their pre-E4b meaning.

disabled.description: Absent on pre-E4b records: loads as false without altering the hash. E4b writers always emit it.
